ai_summary: HP Adhesives Limited has received an Order-in-Original from the Joint Commissioner of Customs, imposing a total of Rs. 65,91,868/- (plus interest) for Anti-Dumping Duty, penalty, and a redemption fine related to imported PTFE Thread Seal Tape. While the company plans to contest the order and states no material operational impact, this significant financial demand represents a material regulatory compliance issue and potential financial burden that will be recorded as a contingent liability.
